##  Shear Moduli {#sec-ISHIHARA}

The shear Moduli <ID.E8FFE23F> of an arbitrary layer at depth <ID.750C34B0> can be estimated in terms of the void ratio <ID.DC498D22> and the octahedral stresses <ID.4B8C0152> from <ID.65D1E868>, where <ID.49BEDB88>, <ID.A3FF954A>, and <ID.5BA2E3E5> are material-dependent constants and <ID.E16ACCB9> is the void ratio of the material, and <ID.4B8C0152> is the octahedral stress at depth <ID.750C34B0> <ID.9AD9CF2F>.  

<ID.897DC86A> {#eq-SM}

The table from <ID.6215D981> presents the parameters of the shear stiffness estimation model together with the range of void ratios in which the correlations were calibrated.

<ID.31979E1F>

The shear wave velocity at the base <ID.1DB9FBDD> can be estimated from the shear stiffness <ID.D672EA97> at the base <ID.7B653AC7> and the density <ID.E2FE34F7> of the material using the relation <ID.63AC8902> <ID.9AD9CF2F>.
